email.body1:
Alexis, saw Ziosk landed Flynn Group across 460-plus Applebee's and rolled out to all 115 Miller's Ale House sites.

Momentum like that usually means more restaurant groups and channel targets worth co-selling into than the team can reach at scale. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own across the partner ecosystem, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Ziosk's partner ecosystem off hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Alexis, quick follow-up for Ziosk.

Partner-sourced pipeline only compounds if every promising operator and reseller gets a personalized, timely touch, and that is exactly where manual outreach caps out. Our multi-channel approach drives 287 percent more responses than single-channel alone.

I had our AI SDR draft three personalized emails to your top partner targets. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through them?
email.body3:
Alexis, last bit of proof for Ziosk.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Ziosk's partner reply rate likely compares to peer restaurant-tech teams. Want to grab time so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Alexis, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling partner-sourced pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. I know a partner enablement calendar fills up fast mid-rollout.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page co-sell pilot playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to Ziosk's partner motion? I will tailor it to you either way.
